observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D5300' visible. The lens is labeled 'Nikon AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G VR'.

Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with a label that reads 'Nikon DIGITAL CAMERA D5300', 'MADE IN THAILAND', 'NIKON CORP. JAPAN', and 'MADE IN THAILAND'. The label also shows serial number '2045753'.

Photo 2 shows the top of the camera with the lens attached. The lens barrel has 'Nikon DX VR' and 'AF-S NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G VR' visible. The camera has a mode dial, power button, and Wi-Fi symbol.
All photos show a watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI'.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear. No visible damage to body or lens.

claims.claim: This is a Nikon D5300 DSLR Professional Camera working perfectly ok with no single fault.
claims.evidence: Photos show the camera and lens, but no proof of functionality. No video or test shot is provided. The claim of 'working perfectly' cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, sensor damage, or software issues).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying a live view on the screen.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal scratches, fungus, or haze not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens front element under bright light, or a video showing the lens being touched and rotated.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with potential internal damage

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger included, or a video showing the battery being inserted and charged.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing battery and charger

risks.risk: Camera may have been tampered with or have a non-original lens.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens barrel showing the serial number and a close-up of the camera's serial number on the body.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-original or tampered

proof_requests: Video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying a live view on the screen.
Close-up photo of the lens front element under bright light.
Photo of the battery and charger included.
Photo of the camera's serial number on the body.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
